results.title: Instructor
results.overview: Martynas, a cocky but kind-hearted Vilnius native, loses his driver’s license due to his foolishness and arrogance. Shrugging it off, Martynas once again upsets his pregnant fiancée, who leaves him and goes to stay with her parents. In an attempt to win her back, he embarks on a seemingly ordinary journey to get his license back, during which he meets an instructor at a strange driving school—and an even stranger teacher.

results.title: Sight & Sound Presents: JOSHUA—Live!
results.overview: Journey alongside the people of Israel as they navigate their new-found freedom in an unforgiving wilderness. When Joshua is called to replace Moses as their faithful leader, tensions mount in the midst of dwindling supplies and approaching armies. With one last fortified city standing between the Israelites and the Promised Land, unexpected help emerges from behind enemy lines and Joshua's trust in God's plan is put to the ultimate test.  Filmed in front of a live audience, this special event invites you to experience one of the most redemptive stories of the Bible come to life like never before!

results.title: There's Something Beyond The Hill
results.overview: At a party, a girl tells a group of people an old tale about a boy who encounters a mysterious man carrying a lantern and a picnic basket on a rural road at night—an encounter that precedes strange events and a terrifying meeting.

results.title: Casting Call
results.overview: Floyd, a lifelong lonely casting director who desperately dreams of having a girlfriend, turns his latest film project into a personal dating app to 'lock in' his perfect leading lady. By manipulating the director into casting 'The One,' he sets out to make her his first-ever romantic partner.

results.title: Queezy visits the Races
results.overview: Wearing a sparkly mini-dress and heels, performance artist Queezy Babaz enters a bustling Cape Town car racing space and interacts with attendees, offering an intimate observation into queer identity and acceptance within the Coloured community.

results.title: All the Way Down
results.overview: Alex, a burnt-out composer, seeks a creative spark when she travels to a mysterious inherited lake property. There, she encounters a family secret and an otherworldly sound that may provide divine inspiration or drive her to madness.

results.title: The Anta Claus of the South Pole
results.original_title: The Anta Claus of the South Pole
results.overview: Envious of his northern counterpart, the Anta Claus of the South Pole embarks on a penguin-powered journey to uncover the secret of a flawless Christmas. Along the way, he learns that the true spirit of the holiday lies not in perfection but in the lovable community of oddballs he left behind.

results.title: Absolution
results.overview: A character driven short drama about grief and survivors guilt set in Las Vegas.

results.title: The Pinecrest Lost Tapes: Chaos! Blood! & Violence
results.original_title: The Pinecrest Lost Tapes: Chaos! Blood! & Violence
results.overview: Since the early 90s, Pinecrest, Massachusetts has suffered unexplained horrors. Nolan vanished without a trace in a winter storm. 23 years later, seven friends in a park discover the Rabbit has returned to Pinecrest.

results.title: Sandwiched
results.overview: Caught between her insatiable Gen Alpha child and her boundary-lacking Baby Boomer parents, a burnt-out Millennial Mom tries to reclaim her sanity.

results.title: These Strange Ashes: The Elisabeth Elliot Story
results.original_title: These Strange Ashes: The Elisabeth Elliot Story
results.overview: After her husband’s murder in the Ecuadorian jungle, a missionary widow wrestles with the true costs of conviction as she transforms into one of the 20th century’s most popular and polarizing female faith figures.

results.title: School Shooters: You Killed Me First
results.original_title: School Shooters: Tú me mataste primero
results.overview: After graduating, Jaime and Chloe plan a massacre at their high school during the summer.

results.title: Every Breath We Take
results.original_title: O Ar Que a Gente Respira
results.overview: A murder investigation in a small rural town, marked by silences and loyalties, uncovers old secrets. Adoniran, a respected investigator, sees his life collapse when he goes from agent to prime suspect. While trying to prove his innocence, Saulo, Special Agent of Internal Affairs, returns to his hometown and must confront memories he would rather forget. Inner conflicts, fragile alliances, and unresolved recollections make the search for truth increasingly dangerous.

results.title: Grampa
results.overview: A young Black man visits his white boyfriend's family for the first time and balks at the lengths they'll go to excuse their patriarch's monstrous behavior.

results.title: Sweet New Suit
results.overview: This film takes place within the lives of two friends that conflict with one another, as "Q" can't take responsibility for his actions and loosely getting "Jazz" involved.

results.title: Glückspilze isst man nicht
results.overview: The eccentric scientist Frieda Hofstätter is on the verge of being cast aside. Then the Valkyrie Wolkentruth appears to take her to Valhalla. But Frieda refuses and strikes a deal: Wolkentruth must help her save Frieda’s CO2-storing miracle mushroom. Only then may she take Frieda with her. Together, they race against time—and perhaps for the future of the world.
